notes.title: Announcement: New Title "Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-" Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [p]To celebrate the Steam Next Fest featuring our new title [b]"Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-"[/b], we’re holding a [b]20% OFF sale[/b]![/p][p][b]"Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-"[/b] is a 2D shoot 'em up × block-breaking game featuring characters shared with [b]"Nail's Chaotic Craft!"[/b].[/p]

notes.title: 『Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence- 』Announcement: Demo Release
notes.content:
April 12, 2025

We have released the demo version of "Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-".

In this demo, you can play Stage 1 (Standard difficulty only) with all three available characters.
We hope you enjoy experiencing the game firsthand!

■ URL
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652340/Manalia_Notes_A_memory_of_innocence_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652340/Manalia_Notes_A_memory_of_innocence_Demo/[/url]

notes.title: Now compatible with macOS!
notes.content: The title was previously Windows-only, but it is now compatible with macOS as well. We have confirmed its functionality on a MacBook Pro 2018 (Intel CPU).
